copy.tagline: 处理医疗数据科学中的临床编码与成本分配规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理医疗数据时需处理临床编码层级与空值语义。
copy.tagline_en: Handle clinical coding hierarchies and cost allocation in healthcare data science.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with encounter-based clinical data and need to manage coding hierarchies and NULL semantics.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在处理医疗健康数据时会遵循规则：用事件表驱动分析、保持就诊事件粒度、使用编码层次结构、从完整分类表构建映射、成本分摊需去重、NULL视为未记录而非不存在。
howto.when: 当用户询问医疗数据汇总、编码处理、成本分摊或缺失数据解读时触发。

say.text: 门诊患者总费用汇总，注意各诊断分摊。
say.note: 触发成本分摊规则，避免重复计算。

say.text: 将ICD编码按父级分组统计。
say.note: 使用编码层次结构实现。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude follows healthcare data science rules: drive from event tables, respect encounter-level grain, use code hierarchies, build mappings from full taxonomy left-joined with crosswalk, deduplicate cost allocation, and treat NULL as unrecorded, not absent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks about aggregating clinical metrics, handling diagnosis/procedure codes, allocating costs, or interpreting missing data.

say_en.text: Summarize total cost for outpatient encounters, considering cost allocation per diagnosis.
Group ICD codes by parent hierarchy.
